sentences.en: I have found a dead cockroach in the meeting room.
sentences.zh: 我在会议室里发现了一只死蟑螂。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've ever squashed a cockroach.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次碾死一只蟑螂。

sentences.en: Look! There's a cockroach besides the fridge! Do something quick!
sentences.zh: 看！冰箱旁边有一只蟑螂！快点做些什么！
